content.comment_body: Hello, I'm developing a new data reporting system and one of the devices on the shop floor is a [product_name] controller. Is it possible to connect Kepserver to this controller without needing additional hardware? I came across a YouTube video showing this type of connection, but they don't share details on their hardware setup. I tried to follow the same approach, but my connection isn't working.
Maybe this YouTube video can help. [product_name] V8 con OPC KEPServer - YouTube
That's the video I watched and tried to reproduce yesterday, but I couldn't get it to work.
Were you ever able to get this working?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble connecting a [product_name] controller to KepServer for a data reporting setup. There is insufficient documentation and guidance about the integration, particularly with respect to hardware requirements. This leads to confusion about compatibility and difficulties in achieving a successful connection.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear instructions and straightforward compatibility for connecting a [product_name] controller to KepServer, preferably without extra hardware. They are seeking reliable, easy-to-follow integration guidance.
